task: binary classification of peptides as antioxidant vs not; probability in [0, 1], called antioxidant at >= 0.5
architecture: average-logit ensemble: sigmoid(mean of the logits of CNN, BiLSTM and Transformer base models on one-hot residues, padded to 68); the notebook's stacker is not used
input_encoding: one-hot over 20 standard amino acids, zero-padded to 68

training_data.split: train sheet split 80/20 into train/val by CD-HIT 90% identity clusters (StratifiedGroupKFold, seed 42); base models early-stopped on val loss; Antiox_test sheet (444 neg / 447 pos, lengths 1-29) held out
